def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    starting_assets = 160.0
    growth_rate = 0.25
    high_watermark = 198.0
    management_fee_rate = 0.02
    hurdle_rate = 0.10
    performance_fee_rate = 0.20

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    ending_assets = starting_assets * (1 + growth_rate)
    management_fee = ending_assets * management_fee_rate

    # The 10% soft hurdle is net of the management fee.
    hurdle_value = starting_assets * (1 + hurdle_rate) + management_fee
    net_ending_assets = ending_assets - management_fee

    incentive_base = max(0.0, net_ending_assets - max(high_watermark, hurdle_value))
    performance_fee = incentive_base * performance_fee_rate

    total_fees = management_fee + performance_fee

    # return answer
    return round(total_fees, 1)
